issues.description: Lesson 'obj-teach-pandas-basics' exists in the lessons array but is not referenced in 'module-01' lesson_ids array.

technical_review.notes: There is a severe contradiction in time constraints, and an orphaned lesson exists[cite: 17].

special_question.answer: No, the design is pedagogically flawed due to severe time contradictions.
special_question.notes: The summative assessment explicitly demands a 45-minute time limit, yet the course outline only reserves 10 minutes for it, creating an impossible schedule within a 60-minute constraint[cite: 17].

rubric_scores.rationale: Objectives have well-defined, observable success criteria[cite: 17].
The performance task directly covers data inspection, transformation execution, and written justification[cite: 17].
A hands-on coding task combined with written rationale is the gold standard for data processing competencies[cite: 17].
Tasks and objectives align across analyze, apply, and evaluate levels[cite: 17].
Listing pandas basics as a prerequisite but attempting to optionally teach it in a 5-minute remedial lesson ('obj-teach-pandas-basics') is highly unrealistic[cite: 17].
Detecting issues before transforming and justifying is the correct logical flow[cite: 17].
The instruction relies heavily on short demonstrations, which may not adequately prepare novices for a demanding 45-minute summative coding test[cite: 17].
There is a massive risk of under-teaching. You cannot teach pandas detection methods, complex imputation, and trade-off evaluation in 15 minutes of effective instruction time[cite: 17].
Content is relevant to the target capability[cite: 17].
Requires major redesign to resolve the time constraint contradictions and handle pandas prerequisites appropriately.

prerequisite_acceptance.notes: prereq-02 (pandas basics) must be confirmed prior knowledge, not something crammed into a 5-minute side lesson[cite: 17].

edit_effort.notes: Remove the orphaned remedial lesson, revise assessment time limits, and elevate pandas basics to a hard prerequisite.

pedagogical_review.overall_notes: A structurally logical design that collapses under unrealistic time budgeting and contradictory duration specifications[cite: 17].
